name: ATLAS-W — Crew & Sound
changedScope: Seven additive product files under atlas_w_immersion/live. Original fleet, sailing host, both vessel dynamics, avatar assets, original rig modules, projectile/explosion modules and earlier previews remain unchanged.

sound.origin: Original synthesized game audio; not field recordings or real-weapon measurements
features: Independent port/starboard engine sources responding to actual simulated shaft thrust
Wind/wash responding to speed and motion; turret motor responding to slew
Camera-following spatial listener, HRTF panners and distance attenuation/filtering
Game sound-propagation delay; target impacts distinct from water splashes
Separate transient, low-frequency tail and mechanical sounds
User-enabled audio with volume and reduced-dynamic-range option
Pause/hidden/mute/reset/dispose cleanup and rapid enable/mute race protection
Optional audio graph failure is contained without breaking sailing
Same licensed textured avatar at the first-/third-person station
Posture responds to ship pitch, roll, acceleration and turret movement
Control-stick movement, trigger-finger motion, small firing reaction and recovery
Input-triggered console gesture and regrip; left hand marked unsupported during gesture
Live console heading, speed, power, traverse, elevation and activity readings
Steady-camera comfort option; first-person headset/head hidden
crew.representation: Presentation-only fictional seated operator, not a real person or military training

controls.1_2_3: First person / third person / ship view
controls.V: Look at hands and live console
controls.More: Volume, reduced loudness, steady camera and manual aim

tests.scope: Local Node execution; actual Three scene/skeleton/skin geometry with synthetic DOM and test-only texture decoding bypass. Actual PCM generation, but Web Audio graph/scheduling tested with fake AudioContext interfaces, not device output.

audioAudition.scope: Offline stereo mix using these exact synthesis functions; not a browser/HRTF/gameplay recording

retainedCorrections: Initial console gesture exceeded the original hand-reach assertion; shortened gesture, original assertion retained
Signed-zero sample endpoints corrected to exact zero
DSP high-pass state kept separate from output saturation; added explicit DC/level check
Optional audio failure containment added and tested
publicReceipt: Ordinary web-reader access to the exact public URL returned inaccessible. Source publication confirmed; no public HTTP, rendered browser, native touch or device-audio receipt claimed.
limits: No new browser, CI or workflow execution; earlier blocked automation was not retried or routed elsewhere
No GPU shader, texture, physical phone, Safari, audible hardware output, FPS, battery or optical-latency verification
Synthesized sound, not real ship recordings; improved layering does not establish perceptual realism on a device
Ship/ocean/terrain/handling and projectile/explosion model unchanged; not a complete photorealistic or calibrated naval simulation
No full-body ergonomic/collision acceptance, military operations, manual loading, multiplayer or previous HUMANS/CORE approval transfer
Recoil remains visual; damage limited to existing practice targets/water
Existing long-render interruption pause remains and may require native Resume
Old immutable public URLs remain unchanged; use this preview URL
